source.place: Tag 0941 and the finite evaluation/counit assembly described in the item proof; this stage-3 decomposition isolates the existence and uniqueness/assembly subarguments.

proof.text: Choose independently the tensor and pullback realizations normalized on strict quotient models. These supply the two functor isomorphisms and their model predicates.

Choose the existing full coefficient evaluation calculus. Normalized reconstruction makes its counit invertible at every normalized system. Left-adjoint uniqueness for the common right adjoint identifies the S and V counits with this counit after an isomorphism, so their actual counits are invertible.

Derive the unit-normalized inverse-image evaluation isomorphism using exact-functor derived composition. Define each beta as the realization followed by the functor image of the counit. Invertibility follows by functoriality. Compose the realization isomorphism with the functor image of the supplied counit isomorphisms; its inverse is definitionally the displayed word. Naturality is naturality of the composite of whiskered natural transformations, in the tensor case using the product of the two counits. Counit naturality and projection naturality are the existing natural transformations. These data fill every field of Comparisons.
